<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/runs/{id}/cancel"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Cancels an in-flight pipeline run: stops its invocation loop and
marks the run failed with a cancellation error. Already-staged
nodes/edges are retained for diagnostics. No-op if the run is not
currently executing in this process or is already terminal.
